description: Defines a Markdown content type class implementing conversion and caching functionalities for Markdown content within a documentation framework.

classes.name: ContentType
classes.description: Implements a Markdown content type handler with conversion and caching support.

methods.name: createConverter
methods.description: Creates a new CommonMarkConverter instance configured with current settings.

methods.name: getConverter
methods.description: Returns the existing converter or creates one if not initialized.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns supported file extensions for Markdown.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts raw Markdown content into HTML, utilizing caching where possible.
